title: The unfinished handoff
body: The gate key is pinned under a closure notice dated after the guard shift ended. Someone wedged a bat across the latch from the inside.
rival_reading: A program site could also have been closed to visitors; the late notice and blocked gate do not identify who ordered it.
gloss: A gate closure appears after the listed shift, with the inside latch still blocked.

title: Kept from the drawer
body: Leave the canisters outside the fence until the grounds crew finishes the test. The gate was already locked when the delivery arrived; the return form charges us for the missing seal.
rival_reading: Emergency crews could have restricted access and returned sealed containers; the note does not say what was inside.
gloss: A grounds test and a locked gate leave a delivery outside its expected handoff.
